🚨The deadline to sign up for #healthcare coverage is TOMORROW. Don't miss this chance to get quality health insurance for 2022 — coverage that is cheaper than ever thanks to the #AmericanRescuePlan.
https://t.co/KHdCWmM9cX

Today, I voted to pass the EVEST Act, which will automatically enroll all eligible veterans into @DeptVetAffairs healthcare services.   This bill will ease the transition process for our veterans and help set them up for success after military service.

Are you enrolled in or eligible for #Medicaid, WIC, or #SNAP? If so, you probably qualify for a discount on your internet bill thanks to the new Affordable Connectivity Program from the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law I voted for!
 
See if you’re eligible ➡️ https://t.co/EwaBw85pnd

My battle with cancer changed my life. For decades, I’ve been proud to fight in Congress to fund #cancer prevention and treatment.

On #WorldCancerDay, we imagine a world without cancer and recommit ourselves to making life-saving cancer treatment & care equitable and accessible.

Today is National Black HIV/AIDS Awareness Day.

Black people suffer from HIV/AIDS at disproportionately high rates. While much progress has been made to slow this epidemic, we have a long way to go to end #HIVstigma and fully address barriers to testing, prevention, & treatment.

ICYMI: I led 60+ Members in a letter to Congressional leadership urging relief for office-based specialists, who are facing #Medicare pay cuts of up to 20%.

These cuts threaten to undermine health equity, accelerate health system consolidation, & undercut our pandemic response. https://t.co/qnw4pqfyHu

Barack Obama became the first Black president of the United States after the 2008 election, which saw record turnout among African Americans & Hispanics. As president, he signed the Affordable Care Act into law, providing health care coverage to millions of Americans. #IL01BHM https://t.co/XzqWlfi2D0

.@SenRonJohnson once again revealing Republicans' insatiable hunger for repealing the Affordable Care Act and stripping #healthcare away from vulnerable Americans and people with pre-existing conditions.

We can't let it happen.
https://t.co/zI9xe1pYnf

I'm elated that funding for critical community projects in #IL01 was included in the omnibus bill that will soon be signed into law! From job training to arts and STEM programming to investing in health and recreational facilities in our district, this $$ will have a huge impact. https://t.co/gHNENOW8Ls

On #EarthDay, I celebrate the life and legacy of #HazelMJohnson. Known as the mother of #EnvironmentalJustice, Johnson was an activist from Chicago’s South Side whose work helped shed light on the disproportionate health & environmental effects on communities of color. https://t.co/Q5FU8I4VCD

It is a great honor to receive the #AOA Health Care Leadership Award, as I have enjoyed working closely with @AOAConnect over the years, fighting for better patient safeguards & improved access to the eye & vision care all Americans need & deserve.

Today, I announced my funding priorities sent to the @AppropsDems that include addressing environmental & energy justice, solving Civil Rights–era cold cases, improving school drinking water, & increasing healthcare access. 

Here is the breakdown of my requests: https://t.co/jxIWAO27RT

Cleaning Up School Drinking Water — Funding efforts to reduce lead in school drinking water. 

@CDCgov warns that lead exposure can seriously harm kids’ health, including brain & nervous system damage, slowed growth & development, and hearing & speech problems https://t.co/Z8uc0v0Xok

Increase Funding for @NIH’s @AllofUsResearch program — All of Us aims to improve health & disease research. Funding will help enroll 1 M Americans into national research studies, including adequate representation by minorities & other underserved populations. https://t.co/9loaj2qGvS

As today marks the beginning of #NationalNursesWeek, I want to give a heartfelt thanks to nurses in the 1st District & across the country. Their experience, expertise, & compassion makes a major impact on their patients & helps keep our communities strong. https://t.co/khUAhP10rT

Elected officials cannot cherry-pick morality when it eliminates rights from a minority group. 
We must #TrustWomen to make their own healthcare choices. https://t.co/ppqwUfi0JO

Guns have taken a tragic toll on America's kids. @Everytown states that #GunViolence is the leading cause of death for U.S. children & 3 million American kids witness a shooting each year—which takes a horrific toll on their health. 
#GunViolenceAwarenessMonth https://t.co/EN9xgibifk

Last night, I voted for H.R. 7666, the bipartisan Restoring Hope for Mental Health & Well-Being Act, which passed the House. Mental health is a serious issue & we need to provide resources & support to the millions of Americans struggling w/mental health & substance abuse crises.

Mental health resources have always been important for college students, but campus counseling centers have seen a pandemic-related increase in demand. Today, I voted for the Enhancing Mental Health & Suicide Prevention Through Campus Planning Act to better support students.
If the conservative pro-life movement really cared about the lives of children, they would be supporting mothers & children instead of prohibiting healthcare access & oppressing women.

Honored to participate in the ribbon cutting at Friend Health Center in #Woodlawn today w/ @chicagosmayor & community leaders. This new health center is set to serve thousands of South-Side families, in areas that include dental, pediatric, mental & women’s health care. https://t.co/eg98a2q035

During my time in Congress, I have worked to address the racial disparities in the health care system. This #MinorityMentalHealthAwarenessMonth, @TheBlackCaucus & I reaffirm our commitment to breaking systemic barriers that Black & Brown Americans face w/ mental health care.

The GOP wants to put women’s bodies under state control. We cannot let them punish women for making their own choices. That is why I voted for the Women's Health Protection Act.  #WHPA https://t.co/qFOqPNq2IB

Suicides shatter families & communities, which is why mental health resources are crucial.  

Tomorrow, those in need can call 988, which will connect them directly to the national suicide & crisis prevention hotline w/ trained crisis counselors. #988Lifeline https://t.co/AUiCZE559n

Although it is a shame that it took them 2 tries to get it over the finish line, I am relieved that the Senate finally put #VeteransOverPolitics by passing the #PACTAct last night. Once signed into law, this bill will expand health care & benefits to all toxic-exposed veterans.
